ledger: C7 · A branch is cut only from a base the remote has
ledger_text: "Labels are blocked alone; the STOP comment names the missing base; no branch pushed, no CR opened." (a mistyped or retired `default_branch` used to cut an empty branch from nothing and open a CR against it — issue #38; until #90 its two anchors pinned the bare `git merge --no-edit <default_branch>` / `git diff <default_branch>...` — the local ref — as the required form)
